question.text: Priya is considering a career as a research analyst. According to the NISM workbook, which of the following is NOT listed as an important quality desired in a research analyst?

answer.text: Being good with numbers and data analytical tools
Curiosity and willingness to ask questions and pay attention to detail
Ability to execute high-frequency trading strategies
Strong communication skills to articulate findings clearly

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the NISM Research Analyst workbook (p.20), the listed desired qualities include being good with numbers and data analytical tools, understanding financial concepts, reading financial statements, asking questions, paying attention to detail, and communication skills. Executing high-frequency trading strategies is not in that list. The Trap: The other options paraphrase qualities that do appear on the workbook's p.20 list. High-frequency trading is an execution / algorithmic-trading skill, not a research-analyst quality. Note: Page 19 separately describes independence and ethics as interaction / role expectations rather than as items on the qualities list — keep the answer scoped to the p.20 list.
